Question:
Imperium doesn't have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
Premises:
FormedIn(DiamondMine, wwe) ::: Diamond Mine was formed in WWE.
Leads(RoderickStrong, DiamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(DiamondMine, CreedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(DiamondMine, IvyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(Imperium, DiamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
¬Feud(Imperium, y) ∨ ¬Includes(y, IvyNile) ::: Imperium doesn't have a feud with any stable that includes Ivy Nile.
